title: Execute policy-selected optimization candidates automatically
description:
As an account operator, I want periodic portfolio optimization to execute policy-selected candidates without waiting for a blocking approval, so that unattended runs can make bounded progress while unsafe or ambiguous targets remain stopped.

Feature: Automatic portfolio optimization execution

Scenario: Run eligible candidates automatically
  Given a portfolio run has automatic execution mode frozen into its run identity
  And deterministic analysis has produced current, complete, ready, non-stale, non-cooldown candidates
  When the run reaches optimization execution
  Then it launches only those policy-selected candidates
  And every launch remains within the exact cost, sample, iteration, and concurrency limits
  And it does not create a blocking optimization-approval action

Scenario: Preserve optional human approval mode
  Given a portfolio run has approval-required execution mode frozen into its run identity
  When ready candidates are selected
  Then the run publishes an evidence-bound approval action
  And it launches only independently approved current targets

Scenario: Refuse unsafe automatic launches
  Given a target has stakeholder ambiguity, structural repair needs, incomplete evidence, stale evidence, active cooldown, or another readiness blocker
  When automatic execution policy is applied
  Then the target is not launched
  And the living Report shows its rejection reason and next action

Scenario: Report automatic execution clearly
  Given an automatic portfolio run selects, launches, or rejects targets
  When the living Report is revised
  Then the same Report identifies the frozen execution mode
  And it reconciles selected, launched, and rejected targets with reasons
  And no champion is promoted automatically

Out of scope:
- Automatic champion promotion.
- Automatic guideline or feedback-setting changes.
- Launching targets with policy ambiguity or incomplete evidence.
- New GraphQL models, resources, or schema changes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Product direction recorded before implementation: the periodic portfolio procedure defaults to fire-and-forget automatic execution, while approval-required behavior remains an explicit frozen mode. The current bounded dogfood run is intentionally left unchanged to capture evidence from the existing approval-required path. No source edits begin until that run reaches its next durable outcome. Planned delivery order: outside-in mode-contract specifications, runner and procedure integration, Report/workbook projection, focused validation, then independent review. No new schema resources or automatic champion promotion are permitted.
